about: BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET, Level 2 (the Poolrooms). Sound list for plan v3, 2026-10-10. One ambient bed per section, three new spatial loops, 45 one-shots that belong to one section each. Written by the lead from the map survey; prompts are for ElevenLabs text-to-sound-effects.

beds.place: a small tiled kiosk standing alone on open desert, the level's start
beds.prompt: Wide open desert at midday heard from inside a small tiled kiosk with its door open: a steady light dry wind over sand, a soft low whistle through a gap, fine sand grains ticking on glass now and then. Vast empty outdoor air, no birds, no insects, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a hard narrow tiled stairwell and a locker changing room
beds.prompt: Room tone of a narrow tiled stairwell beside an empty changing room: close boxy air, one old fluorescent tube humming with a faint electrical buzz, a small extractor fan turning behind a wall, short hard echoes. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a flooded cistern hall of 104 tiled columns, ankle-deep still water, ceiling 17 m
beds.prompt: Room tone inside a vast flooded underground cistern with a hundred tiled columns: deep hollow cool air, countless tiny far-off water trickles blended into one soft continuous wet murmur, a long smooth cathedral reverb. Still water: no waves, no lapping, no splashes, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a concrete service stair on steel grating with iron pipes
beds.prompt: Room tone of a concrete service stairwell full of iron pipes: water rushing softly inside the pipes, a warm low boiler hum, a faint steady metallic ring from the steel grating, close dry concrete echoes. No drips, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a colossal concrete nave, ceiling 25 to 45 m, the biggest space in the level
beds.prompt: Room tone of an enormous empty concrete hall forty metres high: slow heavy air moving through the space, a deep distant rumble of far machinery, a faint hollow wind tone drifting between giant columns, a huge long dark reverb. Dry and cold, no water, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a narrow concrete culvert beside a stepped water cascade
beds.prompt: Room tone inside a narrow concrete water culvert: a dense close hush of water running fast along a channel, a low tunnel resonance that booms softly, damp hard walls very near. Constant flow with no waves, no splashes, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a tiled stepwell shaft with glass rails, 33 m tall, a small pool at the bottom
beds.prompt: Room tone at the bottom of a deep tiled stairwell shaft with glass balustrades: still bright air, a thin high glassy resonance like wind across the rim of a glass, a small steady trickle of water echoing from far below, hard short slap echoes. No waves, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a low wet stone corridor with wall vents and a drain channel
beds.prompt: Room tone of a low stone service corridor: a soft tonal air-duct drone with a slow beating wobble, a narrow drain channel gurgling quietly along the floor, damp close walls. No hiss, no drips, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a domed blue and gold mosaic rotunda, 38 m high, a whispering gallery with fountain spouts
beds.prompt: Room tone inside a huge domed mosaic bath-house rotunda: warm round resonant air, a soft low tone like a singing bowl held very faintly, fountain water pouring steadily far across the hall heard as a smooth diffuse reverberant wash, the dome focusing every sound. No voices, no choir, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: an old dark-wood and brass locker room and a concrete stair
beds.prompt: Room tone of an old wood-panelled locker room: warm dry dead air, an electric wall clock mechanism humming softly, a cast-iron radiator ticking very faintly, small close room. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a competition swimming hall with a fabric membrane roof on steel trusses and ribbon windows onto desert
beds.prompt: Room tone of an empty indoor competition swimming hall under a fabric membrane roof: desert wind pressing softly on the roof fabric in slow low flutters, a soft pool filtration hum, wide bright airy room with a long reverb, a perfectly calm flat pool. No splashing, no waves, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a tight corridor of 44 identical doors with lit windows
beds.prompt: Room tone of a long narrow hotel corridor of closed doors: muffled close carpeted air, a faint mains hum behind many doors, one distant ventilation tone, a soft electrical buzz from small lamps. No water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: a dry ten-storey atrium of yellow doors over a drained pool
beds.prompt: Room tone of a dry empty ten-storey atrium lined with hundreds of closed doors: tall dead-quiet air, a faint electrical buzz of many small lamps, a very soft air-conditioning tone from far above, a long empty reverb. Completely dry: no water, no voices, no footsteps, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

beds.place: the cabin and the inside of a fibreglass water-slide tube
beds.prompt: Room tone inside a large fibreglass water-slide tube: hollow plastic resonance, air rushing softly along the tube, a thin sheet of water trickling down its floor, a low drum-like boom of the tube walls. No voices, no screams, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

loops.place: the rusted pump house in the middle of the flooded cistern
loops.prompt: An old rusted pump idling inside a small iron pump house: a slow heavy rhythmic thrum of a motor, a loose cover plate rattling softly on every turn, a faint whine of a worn bearing. Close and mechanical, no water sounds, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

loops.place: four half-submerged impellers turning in the pump bay at the end of the nave
loops.prompt: Large half-submerged impellers turning slowly in a deep concrete pump bay: a slow heavy churn and gulp of thick water on every blade pass, a deep motor drone underneath, a hollow wet resonance of the basin. No splashing at the surface, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

loops.place: the overflow gutter along the edge of the competition pool
loops.prompt: A swimming pool overflow gutter: a thin steady sheet of water slipping over a tiled edge and trickling along a narrow drain channel, small hollow gurgles in the grating. Gentle and close, constant, no waves, no splashes, no voices, no music. Steady, seamless loop.

shots.prompt: In a huge flooded tiled hall: a short run of five or six single water drops falling one after another into shallow still water from a high ceiling, each with a bright plink and a long hall echo, then silence. No voices, no music.

One small hard object, like a loose mosaic tile, dropped onto wet ceramic: a single bright ceramic click that ricochets between tiled columns as a fast fluttering echo and dies away in a large flooded hall. No voices, no music.

Far across a large flooded hall, an old iron pump housing gives one dull heavy metallic clank followed by a short shuddering rattle that settles. Distant, reverberant, then quiet. No voices, no music.

Far away in a flooded tiled hall, something slowly stirs shallow water: one soft slow swirl, two gentle wet slaps against a column, then stillness with a long echo. Quiet and unexplained. No voices, no breathing, no music.
A ceramic wall tile cracks with one sharp dry tick, and a small fragment falls into shallow water with a tiny plop, in a large reverberant tiled hall. Then silence. No voices, no music.

A long low moan of air moving through a forest of tiled columns in a flooded cistern: it rises slowly once, wavers and falls away into a long reverb. Wind only, tonal and hollow, not a voice, no music.

A small stone falls down a very deep concrete shaft: it clicks off the walls again and again, each click quieter and further down, fading into nothing without ever landing. Huge hall reverb. No voices, no music.

One enormous distant concrete boom, like a massive slab settling somewhere deep in a colossal empty hall: a low heavy thud and then a very long dark rumbling reverb tail that slowly dies. No voices, no music.
A slow cold exhale of air rising out of a very deep concrete shaft: a soft hollow whoosh that swells and fades once, with a deep resonant undertone from far below. Air only, not a voice, no music.

A sodium vapour lamp high in a huge concrete hall buzzes loudly for a moment, stutters with two electrical clicks and a small glassy tink, then settles back into a steady quiet hum. No voices, no music.
Far away in an enormous concrete hall a heavy iron chain shifts: a slow drag of thick links over concrete, a few heavy clinks, then it settles. Long dark reverb. No voices, no music.

Water surging through a very large pipe somewhere far off in a concrete building: a deep muffled rushing swell that rises, holds for a moment and drains away, with a low boom at the end. No splashing, no voices, no music.

Fine concrete grit and dust trickling down from very high above onto a concrete floor in a vast empty hall: a short dry pattering shower of small grains, a couple of larger pebbles, then silence. No voices, no music.
A large glass balustrade panel under tension gives one clear glassy ping and a short creak, ringing with a long bright shimmer in a tall tiled stairwell. No breaking, no voices, no music.
One single heavy drop of water falls a long way down a tall tiled shaft into a small deep pool: a round deep plunk with a slow tall vertical echo climbing back up. Then silence. No voices, no music.

A long steel handrail in a tall tiled stairwell rings softly as if tapped once far above: a clear metallic note that travels down the rail and decays slowly with a faint wobble. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
A small ceramic tile fragment bounces down five or six tiled stair steps, each bounce lighter and quicker, and comes to rest, in a tall reverberant stairwell. No voices, no music.
A small old brass valve squeaks through a quarter turn, followed by a brief rush of water inside a wall pipe that quickly stops. Close, tiled room echo. No voices, no music.
Two slow wet bare footsteps on tile, heard from several flights up a tall tiled stairwell, far away and echoing, then nothing. Quiet and unexplained. No voices, no breathing, no music.
A very large bronze disc gives one extremely soft low gong-like ring, as if lightly brushed, with a long warm shimmering decay under a great stone dome. Gentle, not struck hard, no voices, no music.
A single water drop falls into a still pool directly under a large stone dome: one bright plink followed by a rapid fluttering ricochet echo spiralling up the dome and fading. No voices, no music.

A soft airy whoosh travels once around the wall of a large domed whispering gallery, moving from one side to the other and fading. Air only, smooth and round, not a voice, not a whisper of words, no music.
A brass ventilation grille ticks three times as it cools, small clear metallic ticks with a warm round echo under a stone dome. Then silence. No voices, no music.
A stone fountain spout chokes for a moment: the pouring water stutters, the pipe gulps air twice with a hollow glug, and the steady pour returns, across a large domed hall. No voices, no music.

A gust of wind presses on the fabric membrane roof of a large empty swimming hall: one slow deep flap of taut fabric, steel cables creaking, the roof settling back. Big bright room reverb. No voices, no music.
High in the roof of a large swimming hall a steel truss ticks as it expands: tick, tick, and a small bright ting, spaced apart, with a long airy reverb. No voices, no music.
One plastic folding stadium seat flips up by itself with a hard hollow clack, somewhere in the empty stands of a large swimming hall, echoing once across the room. No voices, no music.
A stainless steel pool ladder knocks once against the tiled pool edge with a hollow metallic clonk and a brief ring, in a large quiet swimming hall. No splash, no voices, no music.
A swimming pool overflow drain swallows air: three deep hollow glugs getting slower, then a soft sucking gurgle that fades, echoing in a large tiled hall. No voices, no music.

The hard plastic floats of a swimming lane rope click softly against each other along its length, a gentle rattling ripple that runs from near to far across a calm pool and stops. No splashing, no voices, no music.
A door latch clicks shut several floors above in a tall empty hotel atrium: one small precise metallic click and a soft wooden thud, far away, with a long dry echo. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
Somewhere along an upper gallery of a tall empty atrium, a door slowly creaks open a few centimetres on dry hinges and stops. Long dry echo, then silence. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
Two soft slow knocks on the inside of a wooden door, far along a gallery in a tall empty atrium, muffled and distant with a dry echo. Then silence. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
A steel spiral staircase rings faintly as if a single step was trodden high above: one dull footfall on metal and a long quiet ringing of the whole stair, in a tall dry atrium. No voices, no music.

A dry floor drain in the bottom of an empty drained swimming pool gurgles with air: a hollow dry rattling gurgle from deep in the pipe, rising once and fading. No water splashing, no voices, no music.
A small lamp bulb fizzes for a second, crackles and goes out with one quiet glassy pop. Close and dry, small electrical sound in a quiet hall. No voices, no music.
A thin metal locker door swings slowly on a dry hinge and taps shut with a light hollow metallic clack, in a small tiled changing room. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
Three or four wire coat hangers swing and chime softly against each other on a rail, a thin bright metallic tinkle that slows and stops, in a small quiet locker room. No voices, no music.
Water hammer in old iron pipes: three hard knocks travelling away along a pipe run, each further and quieter, with a ringing metallic tail, in a concrete service corridor. No voices, no music.
A steel grating floor flexes under a weight somewhere above: one low metallic groan and a rattle of a loose grate panel settling, in a concrete stairwell. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
A narrow floor drain channel in a stone corridor gurgles: water sucked down in a slow spiral with a hollow throaty gurgle and a final soft glug. Close and wet. No voices, no music.

A metal door handle is slowly pressed down once and released, from behind a closed wooden door in a quiet carpeted corridor: a soft squeak, a click of the latch, the spring return. No voices, no footsteps, no music.
A small wall lamp in a quiet corridor flickers: a short electrical buzz, two faint clicks of a failing starter, then a steady quiet hum again. Close and dry. No voices, no music.

A gust of desert wind throws a handful of sand against a window of a small kiosk: a rising whoosh, a dry hiss of grains on glass, and the wind dropping away again. Open outdoor air. No voices, no music.
A loose metal roller shutter on a small kiosk rattles in a light wind: a few soft uneven clatters and one longer shiver of thin metal slats, then still. Open dry outdoor air. No voices, no music.
